query:
-- Check upcoming scheduled touches
SELECT touchKey, status, COUNT(*) as cnt, MIN(scheduledFor) as earliest_scheduled
FROM leadSequenceQueue
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND status = 'scheduled'
GROUP BY touchKey, status
ORDER BY earliest_scheduled;
